status: design truth only; no conviction, admissibility or appeal decision operative
hierarchy: sealed Court of Appeal judgment/order governs appellate rulings and outcomes actually recorded
certified Crown Court orders, summing-up, verdict and transcript govern the historical trial record
latest signed/served expert report governs X1's individual position where not superseded
signed source statements and native records prove only their maker/content/provenance
advice, grounds, applications and party skeletons remain attributed; truth key cannot decide safety
state_separations: proposed charge | trial count | verdict | conviction order | sentence
trial evidence | trial admission | judicial ruling | jury verdict | appellate characterization
counsel advice | client instruction | draft ground | signed ground | filed/served ground | judicial decision
deadline source | trigger | calculation | late reason | extension application | extension ruling
permission application | trial-judge certificate | single-judge decision | renewal | full-court permission
new material | fresh evidence claim | due-diligence explanation | party submission | admissibility ruling | permitted use
witness account | credibility submission | judicial assessment
expert raw data | technical fact | individual opinion | addendum | service | admissibility | appellate use
digital signature present | valid/invalid/expired/altered/unverifiable | filing state | document truth
appeal allowed/dismissed by count | conviction quashed | acquittal | substitute verdict | retrial order | sentence consequence
privilege claim | waiver scope | filed derivative | inadvertent disclosure | quarantine/clawback | court ruling

required_findings: all charge/conviction events are design states
trial record locators and gaps remain exact
privileged advice never crosses unauthorised audiences/exits
filed grounds and renewal scope are versioned
deadline and extension states are sourced
expert limitations and opinion changes survive
digital-signature state is not document truth
forbidden_findings: trial conviction is safe or unsafe
missing transcript content can be inferred
advice is a filed ground or broadly waived
late evidence is fresh/admissible/credible/material merely because obtained
quashed count equals acquittal or whole appeal outcome unless order says so
